cacheLayout: generations/<gen> immutable + staging/<gen> + atomic active.json + lkg.json
activation: fsync files, fsync staging, rename to generations/<gen>, fsync generations, fsync+rename lkg, fsync+rename active, fsync root, then prune

spaceBudget.totalCache: max_cache_bytes compared with current + staging copy + downloads (peak)
spaceBudget.filesystemProbe: SpaceProbe compared with staging copy + downloads (additional bytes only)
spaceBudget.test: active 8 B + download 8 B: 15 B free rejected, 16 B free accepted although the transaction peak is 24 B

runtimeMaterialization.switch: populate staging, fsync, rename to generation, atomically replace active pointer; previous generation retained
runtimeMaterialization.runningWorker: the running worker keeps its own immutable generation; pairing only adds atomic files to the active one
runtimeMaterialization.hardlinks: cache/artifact files are hard-linked when on the same filesystem, copied+fsynced otherwise

recovery: invalid active pointer falls back to verified lkg
invalid generation falls back to empty cache
crash before pointer swap leaves old generation active
failed runtime materialization leaves the active generation and pointer untouched
durability: every fsync/rename error is propagated; a post-rename active-pointer sync failure reports 'activated but not durably synced' and keeps the generation

budget.spaceProbe: staging copy + downloads vs available bytes

singleFlight: global ensure lock after a lock-free cached fast path; each module fetched exactly once in 8-way concurrent ensure and parallel startup

router.interpretation: the download runs on blocking threads and does not stall reports; one report waited for the single JS worker's prepareDefinition job (~0.83 s), the same head-of-line behavior as the upstream single-threaded Node loop; p50/p95 unchanged

lazy_dispatch: materialize only paired modules and prepare via quickjs

pruneOrdering: old generations are pruned only after the active pointer is durable; a failed root fsync keeps every generation so a reverted pointer cannot reference a deleted directory
